stableIdPolicy.unknownFutureIds: preserve exact raw value; render typed unavailable/placeholder only; never persist placeholder as selection

compatibility.legacyWithoutMetadata: ValidLegacyNoMetadata only after exact semantic validation
compatibility.catalogUnavailable: no normalization, no hard-coded fallback, no save mutation
compatibility.explicitEdit: replace only fields in exact edit mask
compatibility.aliasMigration: none in v001; future aliases must be explicit/versioned/confirmed as contract requires
compatibility.colors: saved exact finite RGB remains authority; palette IDs are selection/provenance only; no nearest-color inference

requiredBeforeActivation: Approve a final production Champion model/prefab identity and immutable source hash; PR #504 is not that approval.

Resolve and approve body-scale bounds/compatibility for all nine existing body preset vectors.
Publish the versioned #183 catalog-set envelope with stable game/catalog/family IDs, schema/content/source revisions, packaged path, requiredness, and raw hash.
Complete #137 profile/write authority and backward-compatible customization metadata/migration before durable commit.
Obtain user visual/product approval after rendered Player/device evidence.
